svg.title: TASR and post-training success, shown separately for 15 settings
svg.desc: Fifteen small scatter plots, one per task and backbone setting. Every panel plots Table I TASR on the horizontal axis and post-training success on the vertical axis for four acquisition methods. No pooled regression is shown; these associations do not establish causation.

g.text: Each panel compares four methods within one task and backbone setting.
Table I · Horizontal: TASR (%) · Vertical: post-training success (%) · No pooled trend or regression.
